note: Skyborne facts no other guide cites. Each restates one claim the .218 guides already held, with its sources.

facts.label: Skyborne classes
facts.value: The new Skyborne race (Alliance High Order) can be a Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue or Warrior.
facts.note: Restated from the What Changed compendium entry 'Races and classes' in guides218.json, with its sources.

facts.label: Skyborne needs a Forever pack
facts.value: The Skyborne race needs a paid Forever pack.
facts.note: Restated from the What Changed compendium entry 'Races and classes' in guides218.json, with its sources.

facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard notes of 16 and 26 Oct 2026)
facts.label: Read Leyline
facts.value: Read Leyline raises your Mana and Health regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. It can be cast while moving, but not while Innervate is active.
facts.note: The 26 Oct notes cut the bonus from 100% to 50%; the 16 Oct notes made it castable while moving.

facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard notes of 16 and 26 Oct 2026)
facts.label: Attuned
facts.value: Using Read Leyline at a Ley Line also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises Read Leyline's bonus to 100% regeneration. Attuned persists through death; entering a raid removes it.

facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard notes of 16 and 26 Oct 2026)
facts.label: Skysight
facts.value: Skysight raises your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec and can be cast while moving.
facts.note: The 26 Oct notes raised the bonus from 10% to 15%.

facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard notes of 16 and 26 Oct 2026)
facts.label: Charged
facts.value: Using Skysight at an elemental convergence also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises Skysight's bonus to 30% movement speed. Charged persists through death; entering a raid removes it.
